name: Mixing Religion And Politics
overview: Scripture teaches that believers must prioritize God's kingdom and righteousness above all earthly authorities, as Jesus instructs us to seek first His kingdom (Matthew 6:33) and to render to God what is His, distinct from worldly powers (Matthew 22:21). The desire to merge religious devotion with political ambition is cautioned against, exemplified by Jesus withdrawing when others sought to make Him king by force (John 6:15). Righteous leadership brings joy to the people, while wicked rule causes mourning (Proverbs 29:2), and believers are warned not to envy or align themselves with evil men (Proverbs 24:1), trusting instead in Christ’s promise to receive all who come to Him (John 6:37).
